meta.name: PYAAS CRM trigger configuration
meta.architecture: hybrid — in-house orchestration core, external vendor for AI outbound calls
meta.note: Every trigger MUST pass the guard chain in `guards.evaluation_order` before dispatch. A trigger that fires but fails a guard is logged as suppressed with the failing guard id — it is never silently dropped.
deviations_from_playbook: C-01 product labelling — every product-referencing message names the supply source (Parag / PYAAS own-brand)
C-02 credit split — refundable wallet top-up and non-refundable promotional credit use different templates and different ledger accounts
C-03 opt-out bar — 90-day suppression after any opt-out, applied to all promotional triggers
C-04 consent validity — explicit consent carries an expiry; promotional triggers check freshness, not just presence
C-05 header suffixes — DLT headers carry -P / -S / -T / -G
C-06 skip notice timing — D-07 moves from 07:00 to the order cut-off the previous evening
C-07 claims freeze — no A2, breed or origin claim in any template until the herd substantiation file is closed
C-08 SLA hours — resolution SLAs are measured in published support hours, not wall-clock, except safety which is always immediate
meta.revision_note: Revision 2, 20 August 2026 — all ten open values resolved by the client. Wallet ladder re-timed for a 12:00 noon cut-off; AI-call windows constrained to hours in which a human can receive a transfer.

G1_kill_switch.rule: A global switch and a per-trigger switch. Either off = no dispatch. Must be togglable from the admin console without a deploy.

G2_consent.rule: Promotional requires explicit, unexpired consent for the channel. Service and transactional rely on the existing customer relationship. AI calls require call consent recorded separately from message consent.
G2_consent.explicit_consent_ttl_note: Per the TCCCPR amendment of 12 February 2025. Confirm the exact application with the DLT aggregator in writing before building; if the aggregator confirms a longer period for your categories, change this value here and nowhere else.

G3_opt_out_suppression.rule: If opt_out_at is set, block all promotional dispatch for 90 days from that timestamp. Service and transactional messages required to deliver the paid service are never blocked by opt-out.

G4_dnd_scrub.rule: Scrub the recipient list against the DND registry before every promotional campaign and before every outbound call batch. A number flagged fully blocked receives no promotional message and no promotional call, regardless of channel.

G5_quiet_hours.note: TRAI prohibits commercial calls 21:00–09:00. The windows above are deliberately tighter than the regulation. Do not widen them without a written decision.

ai_call_human_backstop.rule: No AI call may be placed at a time when no human is available to receive a transfer. Effective call windows are the intersection of the call window and support hours.
ai_call_human_backstop.consequence: The playbook's 18:00-20:00 evening call slot is unavailable under 9-18 Mon-Sat support. To reopen it, let the 24x7 on-call responder accept AI-call transfers after 18:00.
ai_call_human_backstop.derived_from: AI guardrail 5 — transfer immediately on anger, quality/safety or dispute. A transfer with no destination is not a guardrail.

G6_frequency_cap.rule: Caps are enforced in the orchestration core as hard limits, not as vendor-side settings. A dispatch that would breach a cap is suppressed and logged.

G7_complaint_hold.rule: While a complaint is open for a customer, hold all promotional dispatch to that customer until the complaint is closed. Service and transactional continue.

G8_dedup_window.rule: One message per real event. Channel priority push → whatsapp → sms: if the higher-priority channel is delivered AND read inside the fallback window, cancel the lower-priority send. Never dispatch the same content on two channels within 30 minutes.

G9_channel_availability.rule: Push requires an installed app with a live FCM token and notification permission. If absent, fall through immediately rather than waiting out the fallback window.

G10_template_approved.rule: SMS and RCS require a DLT-registered template id. WhatsApp requires a Meta-approved template id in the correct category. A dispatch with an unapproved or missing template id must fail loudly in staging and be blocked in production.

product_labelling.rule: Any message naming a delivered or ordered product MUST render the supply source. The orchestration core resolves it from the order line, never from the customer record.

wallet_accounts.rule: Two ledger accounts, two balances, two message templates. The app balance screen shows both lines separately. Spend order: promo_credit first (oldest expiry first), then topup.
wallet_accounts.terms_reference: /terms — refund on closure is net of amounts due for delivered Products and any non-refundable promotional credits

entitlement.rule: A promotional entitlement counts as funding for the deliveries it covers. days_of_cover MUST include entitled_free_deliveries_remaining. Every wallet trigger reads this one figure; none of them special-case the campaign.
entitlement.note: Build this before any W trigger. Without it A-05, B-01, B-02 and D-07 all fire against the campaign on day 0 and tell the customer something untrue.

T-A01.en: Welcome to Pyaas! Fresh milk is 2 taps away — recharge your Wallet & place your first order. Help: [SUPPORT_NUMBER].
T-A01.hi: Pyaas mein swagat! Pehla order 2 tap mein — Wallet recharge karein. Madad: [SUPPORT_NUMBER].

T-A02.en: Delivered! Thanks for trying {labelled_product}. Reorder anytime in the app.
T-A02.hi: Deliver ho gaya! {labelled_product} try karne ke liye dhanyavaad. Dobara order kabhi bhi app par.

T-A03.en: Your morning milk starts [DATE], delivered by 7 am. Pause/resume anytime — changes before 12 noon apply from the next morning. Keep your Wallet topped up so it never stops.
T-A03.hi: Aapki subah ki milk [DATE] se, 7 baje tak. Kabhi bhi Pause/Resume — 12 baje se pehle kiya badlav agli subah se lagu. Wallet recharge rakhein.

T-A04.en: Your Pyaas basket is waiting. Finish your order in 1 tap.
T-A04.hi: Aapka Pyaas basket taiyaar hai — 1 tap mein order poora karein.

T-A05.en: One step left — recharge your Wallet to start tomorrow's delivery.
T-A05.hi: Bas ek kadam — Wallet recharge karein aur kal se delivery shuru.

T-A06.en: Need help placing your first order? Reply here or call [SUPPORT_NUMBER] — we'll set it up in 2 minutes.
T-A06.hi: Pehla order mein madad chahiye? Yahin reply karein ya [SUPPORT_NUMBER] par call.

T-B01.en: Your Wallet is running low. Recharge to keep your morning milk coming.
T-B01.hi: Wallet kam hai. Recharge karein taaki subah ki milk na ruke.

T-B02.en: Low balance — recharge by 12 noon tomorrow to receive your delivery.
T-B02.hi: Balance kam — kal 12 baje tak recharge karein taaki delivery mile.

T-B03.en: Your recharge didn't go through. Try again or use another method — no money was deducted.
T-B03.hi: Recharge nahi hua. Dobara try karein — paise nahi kate.

T-B04.en: Your monthly plan renews on [DATE]. Keep your Wallet topped up — nothing else to do.
T-B04.hi: Aapka monthly plan [DATE] ko renew. Bas Wallet recharge rakhein.

T-B05-REFUND.en: ₹[X] added to your Wallet ([REASON]). Refundable. Ready for your next order.
T-B05-REFUND.hi: ₹[X] aapke Wallet mein ([REASON]) jama. Refundable. Agle order ke liye taiyaar.

T-B05-PROMO.en: ₹[X] Pyaas credit added ([REASON]). Usable on orders; not refundable in cash. Valid 30 days.
T-B05-PROMO.hi: ₹[X] Pyaas credit ([REASON]) mila. Order par use karein; cash refund nahi. 30 din valid.

T-C01.en: Miss your Pyaas? Fresh milk & essentials, delivered in minutes.
T-C01.hi: Pyaas yaad aa rahi hai? Taaza doodh & essentials, minute mein.

T-C02.en: We'd love you back — here's ₹[X] Pyaas credit for your next order (valid [N] days, not refundable in cash).
T-C02.hi: Wapas aaiye — agle order par ₹[X] Pyaas credit (valid [N] din, cash refund nahi).

T-C03.en: We noticed a change. Everything okay with your deliveries? Reply here or we can call.
T-C03.hi: Humein change dikha. Delivery theek chal rahi hai? Reply karein ya hum call karein.

T-C05.en: We'll go quiet unless you need us. Reply YES to keep updates, or call [SUPPORT_NUMBER].
T-C05.hi: Hum kam message bhejenge. Updates chahiye to YES bhejein.

T-C07.en: Sorry if yesterday's delivery wasn't perfect. Did everything arrive okay? We'll fix anything.
T-C07.hi: Kal ki delivery mein kami ho to maaf kijiye. Sab theek mila? Hum sudhaar denge.

T-D02.hi: Delivery ke liye nikla — ETA [X] min.

T-D03.en: Running a little late — new ETA [X]. Sorry for the wait.
T-D03.hi: Thodi der ho rahi hai — naya ETA [X]. Kshama karein.

T-D04.en: {labelled_product} is out — okay to swap for [ALT] (similar price)? Reply YES/NO.

T-D05.en: {labelled_product} is unavailable; ₹[X] refunded to your Wallet. Sorry!
T-D05.hi: {labelled_product} uplabdh nahi; ₹[X] Wallet mein wapas. Maaf kijiye.

T-D07.en: No delivery tomorrow — [REASON]. [Recharge by 12 noon today to resume / Resumes [DATE]].
T-D07.hi: Kal delivery nahi — [KARAN]. [Aaj 12 baje tak recharge karein / [DATE] se shuru].

T-D08.en: Your delivery time/area is changing from [DATE] to [NEW]. Questions? [SUPPORT_NUMBER].
T-D08.hi: Aapki delivery [DATE] se [NEW] ho jaayegi. Sawaal? [SUPPORT_NUMBER].

T-E01.en: Sorry we missed the mark. What went wrong? We'll make it right.
T-E01.hi: Kami ke liye maaf kijiye. Kya hua? Hum theek karenge.

T-E02.en: Got it — we're on it. You'll hear back within [SLA] with a fix.
T-E02.hi: Mil gaya — hum dekh rahe hain. [SLA] mein samadhan.

T-E03.en: Sorry today's milk was late. We've added ₹[X] Pyaas credit as an apology (not refundable in cash).
T-E03.hi: Aaj milk late hui, maaf kijiye. ₹[X] Pyaas credit diya (cash refund nahi).

T-E04.en: Sorry! We'll redeliver {labelled_product} or refund ₹[X] to your Wallet — your choice.
T-E04.hi: Maaf kijiye! {labelled_product} dobara bhejein ya ₹[X] Wallet mein — aap batayein.

T-E06.en: Fixed ✅ Thanks for your patience. Anything else? We're here.
T-E06.hi: Theek ho gaya ✅ Dhanyavaad. Aur kuch? Hum yahin hain.

T-E07.en: Thank you! Love Pyaas? Refer a neighbour — you both get Pyaas credit after their first paid order.
T-E07.hi: Dhanyavaad! Pyaas pasand aayi? Padosi ko refer karein — dono ko Pyaas credit.

T-SMS-WELCOME.en: Pyaas: Welcome! Recharge your Wallet & place your first order in 2 taps. Help [SUPPORT_NUMBER]. Reply STOP to opt out.
T-SMS-WELCOME.header_note: RESOLVED — PYAAS-only header. The Parag co-brand is dropped permanently; no sign-off, header or script may carry the Parag mark.

T-SMS-WALLET-T1.en: Pyaas: Low Wallet balance. Recharge by 12 noon tomorrow to receive your milk: [LINK].

T-SMS-PAYFAIL.en: Pyaas: Your recharge didn't complete; no money was deducted. Retry: [LINK]. Help [SUPPORT_NUMBER].

T-SMS-SKIP.en: Pyaas: No delivery tomorrow ([REASON]). [Recharge to resume: [LINK] / Resumes [DATE]]. Sorry for the inconvenience.

T-SMS-CREDIT.en: Pyaas: ₹[X] added to your Wallet ([REASON]). Ready for your next order.

T-SMS-WINBACK.en: Pyaas: We'd love you back — ₹[X] Pyaas credit for your next order, valid [N] days: [LINK]. STOP to opt out.

T-W01.en: You're set. Tomorrow by 7 am: 500 ml Parag Full Cream — delivered by PYAAS, free. No payment now. Recharge Rs500 any time in the next 7 days and your second 500 ml pack comes free with your first paid delivery. Pause or cancel any time.
T-W01.hi: Ho gaya. Kal subah 7 baje tak 500 ml Parag Full Cream — muft, koi payment nahi. 7 din ke andar Rs500 recharge karein to doosra 500 ml pack bhi muft, pehli paid delivery ke saath. Kabhi bhi pause ya band karein.
T-W01.hi_devanagari: सब्सक्रिप्शन शुरू ✅ कल सुबह 7 बजे तक आपका पहला पैक — 500 मि.ली. पराग फुल क्रीम, मुफ़्त। अभी कोई भुगतान नहीं। 7 दिन के भीतर ₹500 का वॉलेट रिचार्ज कीजिए — दूसरा 500 मि.ली. पैक भी मुफ़्त। कभी भी रोकें, बदलें या बंद कीजिए।
T-W01.channel_note: WhatsApp carries the Devanagari rendering. SMS fallback uses the Roman version — a Devanagari SMS carries 70 characters per segment instead of 160.

T-W02.en: Delivered. 500 ml Parag Full Cream — delivered by PYAAS. That one's on us. Want milk tomorrow too? Recharge by 12 noon today.
T-W02.hi: Deliver ho gaya. 500 ml Parag Full Cream — hamari taraf se. Kal bhi chahiye? Aaj 12 baje tak recharge karein.

T-W03a.en: Milk tomorrow? Recharge by 12 noon today. Rs500 is about 8 mornings. Pause or cancel any time. [LINK]
T-W03a.hi: Kal doodh chahiye? Aaj 12 baje tak recharge karein. Rs500 mein lagbhag 8 subah. Kabhi bhi pause ya band karein. [LINK]
T-W03a.note: CH-06 — the service half. Carries no offer, so no promotional consent is required.

T-W03b.en: And your second 500 ml Full Cream is waiting — it comes free with your first paid delivery once you recharge Rs500. Valid 7 days. [LINK] STOP to opt out.
T-W03b.hi: Aur aapka doosra 500 ml Full Cream taiyaar hai — Rs500 recharge par pehli paid delivery ke saath muft. 7 din valid. [LINK]
T-W03b.note: CH-06 — the promotional half. Register separately. Ask the DLT aggregator to classify the combined wording in writing; if they confirm service-explicit, collapse T-W03a and T-W03b.

T-W04.en: Recharge received. Your second 500 ml Parag Full Cream — delivered by PYAAS — is scheduled free with tomorrow's delivery.
T-W04.hi: Recharge mil gaya. Doosra 500 ml Parag Full Cream kal ki delivery ke saath muft.

T-W05.en: Delivered. [labelled_product] plus your second free 500 ml. That completes the welcome offer — from here it's just milk, every morning.
T-W05.hi: Deliver ho gaya. [labelled_product] aur aapka doosra muft 500 ml. Welcome offer poora — ab bas roz subah doodh.

T-W06.en: Your second 500 ml Full Cream is still waiting — recharge Rs500 by [DATE] and it comes free with your next delivery. [LINK]
T-W06.hi: Aapka doosra 500 ml Full Cream abhi bhi taiyaar hai — [DATE] tak Rs500 recharge karein. [LINK]

T-W07.en: Your second free pack has expired — the 7 days are up. Nothing has been charged. Whenever you'd like milk again, it's one tap in the app. [LINK]
T-W07.hi: Aapka doosra muft pack ab uplabdh nahi — 7 din poore ho gaye. Koi shulk nahi laga hai. Jab chahein, app mein ek tap se delivery shuru karein. [LINK]
T-W07.note: "Koi shulk nahi laga hai" is mandatory and must not be shortened out.

T-W08.en: We don't deliver to your area yet. We've noted your pincode and we'll tell you the day we do — that's the only message you'll get from us.
T-W08.hi: Abhi aapke kshetra mein delivery nahi hai. Aapka pincode note kar liya hai — jis din shuru hogi, bata denge. Iske alawa koi message nahi aayega.

triggers.name: Subscription selected, not paid
triggers.note: CH-02. Without this second condition the trigger fires two hours after a campaign signup and tells the customer tomorrow's delivery needs payment — when tomorrow's delivery is already coming free and the promoter said so at the door an hour earlier. NOT disabled globally: it is the right message for a normal signup.

triggers.name: Low balance before next cycle
triggers.note: Threshold raised from 3 to 4 days of cover — a 12:00 cut-off costs the customer most of the final day.

ch03_verification.day0_campaign_subscriber_zero_balance_fr: MUST NOT FIRE — one entitled free delivery is cover
ch03_verification.day1_noon_not_recharged: MUST FIRE — the next day is genuinely unfunded
ch03_verification.note: Corrected by CH-01, not by an exception here. Verify explicitly; do not assume.

triggers.name: Insufficient for tomorrow at cut-off
triggers.note: RE-TIMED for the 12:00 cut-off. Fires at 17:00 on D-2, telling the customer to recharge by 12:00 noon on D-1 for delivery on D. The playbook assumed an evening cut-off and put this the night before delivery; with a noon lock that would be too late. Evening send is retained deliberately — personal admin happens in the evening.

ch03_verification.day0_campaign_subscriber_zero_balance_fr: MUST NOT FIRE — one entitled free delivery is cover
ch03_verification.day1_noon_not_recharged: MUST FIRE — the next day is genuinely unfunded
ch03_verification.note: Corrected by CH-01, not by an exception here. Verify explicitly; do not assume.

triggers.name: Failed recharge / payment
triggers.note: 'no money was deducted' must be verified against the gateway response before rendering. If the gateway reports a pending or captured state, use a different message — an inaccurate money statement is the highest-risk copy in the system.

triggers.name: Not recharged despite reminders → AI call
triggers.note: RE-TIMED. Must complete before the 12:00 lock. Window 10:00-11:45 — starts at 10:00 because that is the earliest permitted call hour.

founding_family.note: Founding Family receive one additional service reminder and this AI call before pause. They are never delivered on a negative balance and never abruptly cut off.

triggers.name: Refund / credit / promo added to wallet
Morning Delivery — quantity reduced / paused / churn signs
Subscription nearing renewal
triggers.note: The playbook lists this in both B and C. Implement once, as B-04. Do not build a second trigger — it would double-send on the same event.

on_no_reply.note: Stop all non-essential dispatch. This is a re-permission trigger — treat silence as a no.

triggers.name: Delivery completed
triggers.note: CH-08. On the free-pack delivery W-02 replaces this message. Without the suppression a campaign customer receives four messages before noon on their first morning, and the first two say nothing W-01 did not.

triggers.name: Morning delivery will be skipped
triggers.note: Fires AT the 12:00 cut-off on D-1 for delivery on D — 19 hours notice. Retain a separate 07:00 run ONLY for causes arising after the cut-off (vehicle failure, area disruption), condition: blocked_reason_arose_after_cutoff == true.

ch03_verification.day0_campaign_subscriber_zero_balance_fr: MUST NOT FIRE — one entitled free delivery is cover
ch03_verification.day1_noon_not_recharged: MUST FIRE — the next day is genuinely unfunded
ch03_verification.note: Corrected by CH-01, not by an exception here. Verify explicitly; do not assume.

triggers.name: MILK QUALITY / SAFETY CONCERN
triggers.sla: human contact within the hour, 24×7, no exception
side_effect: quarantine that batch in the ERP
hold ALL outbound dispatch to this customer except the human handling
triggers.note: NEVER route to AI. NEVER auto-respond. If no human is available the system must escalate to a named phone, not queue a message. This is the one trigger with no working-hours qualification.

triggers.name: Complaint resolved
side_effect: release promotional hold after PT24H, not immediately

triggers.name: AI call — first-order activation
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: AI call — cart abandonment (high basket)
triggers.note: ₹300 is the economically correct threshold — on a ₹15 delivery drop, a ₹36 order spends 41.7% on delivery and a ₹300 order spends 5.0%. Instrument cost_per_recovered_basket from day one; if it exceeds gross margin on the basket, raise the threshold rather than abandoning the trigger.
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: AI call — wallet recharge (Morning Delivery)
triggers.flow: identify_and_consent → explain_shortfall → offer_one_tap_recharge_link → send_link → confirm → offer_pause_as_alternative
triggers.script_reference: G.3 — see spec §9.4. "kal ki delivery pakki" must be replaced; nothing in the system can guarantee a delivery.
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.
triggers.note: RE-TIMED from the playbook's 17:00-20:00. With a 12:00 cut-off an evening save call cannot save the next morning — the indent has already locked.
triggers.script_rule: Do NOT mention any free pack. A call whose purpose is to offer something free is promotional in substance whatever it is labelled, and would pull AI calling into promotional consent, DND scrub and the 90-day bar for no gain. The recharge link opens a screen that already shows the pending pack.

triggers.name: AI call — payment failure / renewal recovery
triggers.note: 'no money lost' must be verified against the gateway state before the call is queued, not asserted by the script.
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: AI call — churn-risk / inactive high-value
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: AI call — post-complaint recovery
triggers.note: Excluded for quality/safety complaints — those close with a human, not a robot checking whether the customer is over it.
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: AI call — feedback after poor experience
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: AI call — win-back, recently cancelled
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.
triggers.note: CH-19. A campaign customer who took the free pack and cancelled was never a paying subscriber. Calling them a win-back candidate puts an AI call in front of someone who has already told us, by not paying, that they were not interested.

triggers.name: AI call — referral request
triggers.window_note: Clipped to support hours — a transfer needs a human to transfer to. Evening slot lost under 9-18 Mon-Sat support.

triggers.name: Welcome offer confirmed
triggers.note: Replaces A-03 for the campaign cohort. Must state exactly what is free and what is not, before any milk arrives.

triggers.name: Free pack 1 delivered
triggers.note: Replaces D-06 on this delivery. Sent at 07:30, immediately after handover.

triggers.name: Cut-off recharge prompt, day one (service)
triggers.note: CH-06. The service half. Sent unconditionally — it carries no offer, so it needs no promotional consent. The real noon cut-off is genuine urgency, not manufactured.

triggers.name: Second pack reminder, day one (promotional)
triggers.note: CH-06. The promotional half, registered separately. A customer without promotional consent still receives W-03a and still sees the pending pack on the screen the link opens. Making the offer conditional on marketing consent would be Forced Action.

triggers.name: Second pack unlocked by first recharge
triggers.note: SETTLED funds only, never payment initiation. Releasing on initiation is trivially exploitable. The pack is scheduled onto the next delivery, not dispatched separately.

triggers.name: Second pack delivered
triggers.note: The free-to-paid boundary. This is the delivery where the customer pays for the first time AND receives something free, so they never experience a morning worse than the last.

triggers.name: Second pack still available
triggers.note: Twice, then stop. Recovering is worth two messages; nagging costs more than the pack.

triggers.name: Second pack window closed
triggers.note: Sets offer.pack2_state = expired. The line "koi shulk nahi laga hai" is NOT optional — a customer who received free milk and then stopped hearing from us will assume something was debited.

triggers.name: Out of area — waitlist captured
triggers.note: One message, ever. This cohort receives no promotional contact at all and exactly one further service message on the day the zone reaches them.

triggers.name: Abuse flag raised
triggers.note: NO customer message. Flag, never auto-reject — genuine multi-family households exist, especially in older Lucknow properties. Support may approve a second offer at the same address on evidence of a separate household. Build the review path before launch.

triggers.name: Promotional stock reconciliation exception
triggers.note: NO customer message. This is the campaign stop-loss condition — promotional stock that cannot be reconciled to consumers created halts the campaign — so it needs an event and an alert, not a spreadsheet.

rules: Identify PYAAS and the purpose of the call within the first 10 seconds.
Disclose that the caller is an AI assistant. Not yet mandated by TRAI; do it anyway.
Ask consent to continue. On a no: thank, end, log, do not retry.
Hard stop at 90 seconds unless the customer is mid-sentence.
Never make a promise the system cannot keep — no guarantee of tomorrow's delivery.
Offer an explicit opt-out in-call and honour it immediately across all channels.
Offer a one-line path to a human on request.
Transfer immediately on anger, abuse, any quality or safety concern, any refund/payment/legal dispute, or two or more failed deliveries.
Respect DND, the call window and the per-trigger cap.
Give a recording notice before recording. Store consent state and outcome for audit.
ai_call_guardrails.vendor_boundary: The vendor executes the call. Eligibility, consent, DND state, caps, do-not-call windows and the decision to place the call are computed in the PYAAS core and passed per call. The vendor must not hold or re-target the customer list.

claims_freeze.rule: No template, script, chatbot answer or AI-call flow may assert an A2, breed, origin, purity or health claim until the herd substantiation file is closed.
claims_freeze.enforcement: CI check — fail the build on these tokens in any template, script or chatbot file: A2, Sahiwal, Holstein, single origin, single-origin, pure, purest, healthier, immunity, medicinal, farm, society, collected at, traceab, फार्म, समिति, संग्रहित, ट्रेस
claims_freeze.extension_ch12: Traceability language is now frozen on any Parag product. The farm record is built from PYAAS own-brand collection data; Parag milk arrives packaged from the milk union and no society, collection time or batch is held for it. Lift the farm tokens only when supply_source is pyaas_own_brand, or when the union supplies batch data in writing.

cutoff_time.means: orders and wallet balance for the next morning lock at 12:00 noon on the preceding day

support.safety_sla: PT1H WALL CLOCK, 24x7, never business hours

campaign_window_gap.issue: The campaign conversion window is 07:00 (free pack delivered) to 12:00 (cut-off). Published opening is 09:00 Mon-Sat, so 07:00-09:00 is unstaffed on six days a week.
options: move Mon-Sat opening to 07:00 for the pilot (recommended)
route 07:00-09:00 to the safety on-call (not recommended — blunts that rota)
campaign_window_gap.status: DECISION REQUIRED — operations, not build. No code depends on the answer; published hours, app, chatbot and printed assets must all state the same thing.

dlt.co_branding: NONE — the Parag co-brand is dropped permanently. No template, script or header may carry the Parag mark.

messaging_vendor.model: single CPaaS covering WhatsApp + SMS/DLT + RCS
messaging_vendor.note: One integration, one template-approval queue. Adapters still sit behind the channel interface so the vendor can be replaced without touching guard logic.

config.credits_note: All issued to the promo_credit account: non-refundable, expiring. Amounts are deliberately inside one to two orders of gross margin. CH-07: welcome credit is 0 for the duration of the Welcome Litre campaign — the welcome benefit is the promotional milk (nil invoiced cost, Rs 72 MRP value). Restore to 3000 when the campaign ends.

wallet_low_threshold.rule: 4 days of cover, computed per plan
wallet_low_threshold.note: CH-11: examples recomputed on Parag prices — the campaign cohort drinks Parag, which carries the same price at every price level because the distributor terms bar any change to its consumer price. The formula is unchanged; only the worked examples were wrong.

founding_family_grace.instead: extended reminder ladder — one additional service reminder and one AI call before pause

welcome_litre.packs_in_entitlement_note: CH-05 rule 3. The work order grants "one litre FCM" and does NOT say two 500 ml packs. If the union supplies a single 1 L pack set this to 1 — W-04..W-07 then no-op and the offer collapses to one free morning. This must be configuration, never a compiled assumption.
eligibility: one per normalised address + geocode within 25 m
welcome_litre.address_match_action: FLAG for human review — never auto-reject. Genuine multi-family households exist; a rule with no appeal generates complaints we cannot answer.

remaining_placeholders.note: short-link domain, must be whitelisted with the DLT platform — use one domain for all templates and register it once
enumerated reason codes, rendered from the event
runtime values from the event payload
Resolves to 96672 60050. This is also the number that goes on every printed campaign asset — not a personal mobile (CH-17).
first_delivery_date + 7 days, rendered in the customer language

traceability_display.rule: Render the traceability block ONLY when order_line.supply_source == "pyaas_own_brand".
traceability_display.else: Render NOTHING. Not a placeholder, not "record unavailable", not a skeleton — an empty block advertises an absence.
traceability_display.layout: No layout shift when absent. Reserve nothing; collapse cleanly.

promotional_order_line.rule: Every promotional pack is issued as a zero-value order line. Never off-ledger.
why: C-01 resolves {labelled_product} from the order line — no line means the message fails
E-05 needs a batch to stop on a quality concern; a free pack is not a lesser pack
fraud controls, daily reconciliation and promoter free-to-cancel rate all become queries
promotional_order_line.accounting: Invoiced cost nil; promotional value at MRP disclosed separately. Same two figures the financial model keeps apart.

analytics_events_added.rule: Reconcile the campaign catalogue and the CRM catalogue into ONE list before either is built. Two event catalogues in one product is how a dashboard ends up disagreeing with itself.
analytics_events_added.privacy: No UPI handle, no VPA, no account number, no full address in any analytics payload.
